Agriculture is the largest private industry in Virginia. This vital pillar of our economy faces significant challenges due to extreme weather, rising costs, reckless tariffs and shrinking markets.

Yesterday, I visited with Brunswick County loggers and beef cattle farmers to discuss their challenges and how Congress can help.

Rural farmers and ranchers serve as the backbone of the American economy. Yet new farmers can face immense challenges getting their business off the ground.

I joined @RepShontel and @RepSalinas to introduce the Farming Opportunities Training and Outreach Grant Program Reauthorization Act to preserve one of our nation’s most vital sectors by supporting beginning and underserved farmers.

America has a maternal mortality crisis. The health care cuts in the Republicans’ Big Ugly Law are making it worse. 

During the @ProtectOurCare “Sick of It” Bus Tour stop in Williamsburg, I explained how. https://t.co/WBae97KIhu

Everyone deserves to access quality health care, when they need it, without going bankrupt. 

But Trump and Congressional Republicans have worsened the health care crisis facing too many communities by slashing over $1 trillion from Medicaid to bankroll tax breaks for billionaires and big corporations in their Big Ugly Law. 

I joined @RepBobbyScott, state officials, patients and advocates for the @ProtectOurCare “Sick of It” Bus Tour stops in Williamsburg and Virginia Beach to call on Congress to reverse the cuts.

Amidst a cost-of-living crisis that forces millions to pay more for groceries, gas, health care, housing and more, nearly half of Virginia households now can’t get enough to eat. Food assistance organizations can’t meet the growing demand.

Meanwhile, the Trump Administration and Congressional Republicans cut food assistance to fund tax breaks for billionaires and support a war of choice in Iran and tariff wars that continue to drive up costs.

Another disturbing example of the Trump Administration weaponizing federal agencies to go after his political enemies… three weeks before an election.

You expect this outrageous behavior from fascist dictators. It has no place in American democracy. I stand with @Ilhan. https://t.co/mJblqRMzb4

Happy #IndigenousPeoplesDay! Virginia has eleven tribes recognized by the Commonwealth, seven of which are federally recognized.

Each has played a pivotal role in shaping our history for thousands of years. Today, we celebrate their rich histories, cultures and traditions. https://t.co/XAlzyQ3Bv1

Title IX is supposed to protect college students from sexual violence. Yet 1 in 4 undergraduate women experience sexual violence.

By gutting the Office for Civil Rights and rolling back Title IX protections, the Trump Administration’s Department of Education has failed Jane Doe, Kendall Francis and countless other students whose stories are not in the news. 

They deserve better. 

I joined @DemWomenCaucus to call for an investigation into the Department of Education’s failure to enforce Title IX.

For over a century, generations of activists and elected officials have fought to enshrine gender equality into the U.S. Constitution. As a state senator, I was proud to carry the legislation making Virginia the 38th and final state necessary to ratify the Equal Rights Amendment in 2020, meeting the constitutional requirements to make it the law of the land.

RATIFIED: A Century of Struggle for the Equal Rights Amendment tells the story of how we did it.

This week, I joined the filmmaker and members of the team that made it happen at @guwgst for a screening and discussion of the work left to be done to achieve gender equality under the law.
